GCD and LCM

Greatest common divisor and least common multiple of two positive integers.

keys
ALPHA→×

GCD is ALPHA ×; LCM is ALPHA ÷. Arguments are comma-separated inside parentheses.

Examples

GCD(28, 35) = 7
LCM(12, 18) = 36
